Context: the channel that had conversations around daisugi testnet is being moved here Yea, short summary for the daisugi-devnet-0 devnet hosted on the panda infra: The devnet is up and activated the daisugi fork today at 16:04 UTC. Its stable and finalizing. I've submitted some PQ test transactions from the handover repo via the public rpc. Worked fine 🙂 https://dora.daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/tx/0x01fb5a14e6af4d73e8e7f62ef2fbbc4bb013ce5bc4e4400716d5c69a09434773?v=frames devnet landingpage: https://daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/ spec doc: https://notes.ethereum.org/@pk910/daisugi-devnet-0 public RPC: https://rpc.daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/ public beacon api: https://beacon.daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/ the network genesis configs are here: https://github.com/ethpandaops/daisugi-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-0/metadata Those can be used to hook up the other explorer (the pq team built a custom EL explorer) checkpointz is available too for checkpoint sync. Drop me your wallet addresses or anything to send funds to (your own faucet or so), or just highlight me for requests. Thanks for the specs! We’ll be joining soon

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
Yea,  short summary for the daisugi-devnet-0 devnet hosted on the panda infra:
The devnet is up and activated the daisugi fork today at 16:04 UTC. 
Its stable and finalizing. I've submitted some PQ test transactions from the handover repo via the public rpc. Worked fine 🙂
https://dora.daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/tx/0x01fb5a14e6af4d73e8e7f62ef2fbbc4bb013ce5bc4e4400716d5c69a09434773?v=frames

devnet landingpage:  https://daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/
spec doc:  https://notes.ethereum.org/@pk910/daisugi-devnet-0
public RPC: https://rpc.daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/
public beacon api:  https://beacon.daisugi-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/

the network genesis configs are here: https://github.com/ethpandaops/daisugi-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-0/metadata
Those can be used to hook up the other explorer (the pq team built a custom EL explorer)
checkpointz is available too for checkpoint sync.

There is a public faucet deployed too. All core devs should have access to free drops via the login.
Drop me your wallet addresses or anything to send funds to (your own faucet or so), or just highlight me for requests.
